text:
maria: Quick sync — I want to capture the full edge-case inventory for Gen API before we lock the PRD. Focus: streaming resume, truncation behavior, token-limit enforcement, and retry semantics. Who's got time now?

alex: I can start a quick draft of acceptance criteria. thinking we need concrete SLOs + test hooks. :memo:
samir: Will add perf constraints (p95 latency under sample load) and a few failure modes (KV cache invalidation on resume).
emily: From customers: 1) resumable streams across reconnects, 2) deterministic truncation warnings, 3) stable token-cost calc. They ask for clear fallbacks.
maria: Agree. We should scope for launch vs. post-launch. Proposal: Launch includes "deterministic truncation" + consistent retry idempotency; streaming resume can be beta flag. Thoughts?
julian: Lean launch. Beta stream resume is OK if we provide rollback+metrics. Main ask: define what "deterministic truncation" means in acceptance terms.
alex: Draft AC snippet: ```acceptance_criteria:\n- truncation_mode: server returns "truncated": true + truncation_reason ("token_limit"/"time_limit") when cut\n- token_window: model enforced at 4096 tokens by default, configurable per-tenant\n- resume_id: resume token valid for 60s and idempotent\n- retry_policy: automatic single retry on transient 5xx, with resume token preserved\n```
samir: Add edge cases: heavy-system-load where token accounting drifts, client reconnects with different session metadata, and mixed model fallbacks (quantized variant).
emily: Also include UX for clients: a lightweight header when streaming starts: `X-Resume-Id: <id>` and `X-Approx-Tokens-Remaining: <n>` so SDKs can show warnings.
qa-bot: Test cases I'll add: 
- TC1: stream interrupted after chunk N, client reconnects with same resume id -> resume continues from token N+1.
- TC2: truncation event occurs mid-stream -> final event contains `truncated:true` and `truncation_reason` and partial KV cached state discarded.
- TC3: retries during token-limit -> server returns 4xx if request overshoots max tokens; retry should not double-bill tokens.
- TC4: mixed-model fallback -> if primary model OOMs, fallback to smaller quantized model and emit event `fallback_model_used` with latency delta <= 2x.
maria: Nice. For scope negotiation with Eng runtime: can we get commit on resume token semantics? I want idempotency and no double billing as must-haves.
julian: Runtime question: resume semantics require MVCC on KV cache and GC window. We can support resume within 2 minutes if we keep cache pinned. That affects memory footprint and Dedicated pricing.
alex: So tradeoff: Launch (GA) requires resume within 30s or not at all? If we set GA to 30s we risk infra cost. Suggest GA = no guaranteed resume, Beta = resume up to 120s.
emily: Customers with Dedicated care about cost — they'd pay for pinned caches. Recommend: Dedicated: 120s resume SLA; Hosted: beta 30s best-effort. Put this in PRD as table.
samir: Also need to call out token-limit enforcement: server must atomically check prompt_tokens + completion_estimate <= tenant_limit and reject early with 413 and error code `token_limit_exceeded`. That prevents wasted cycles.
qa-bot: I'll assert acceptance: error code 413 + `retryable:false` for user-specified oversize; for transient infra token-count mismatch -> 5xx and retryable:true.
maria: Pre-launch checklist items: 
- PRD covers AC + infra tradeoffs
- Eng runtime doc with memory impact and config knobs
- SDK patch to surface resume ID headers and truncation events
- QA test plan + canary run (100k tokens/day for 48h)
- Billing alignment to ensure resume doesn't double-bill

alex: Launch criteria proposal (GA): 
- deterministic truncation behavior implemented and unit-tested
- token-limit early rejection in place (413)
- retry policy documented + integration tests
- SDKs surfaced resume headers (even if hosted resume is beta)
- Beta telemetry collection for streaming resumes -> sampling enabled

emily: Timeline ask from sales: customers want deterministic truncation by EOW (1 week). Is that realistic?
samir: If we scope truncation as server-sends `truncated:true` and code path short-circuits tokens before model call -> yes 1 week for core behavior. Full billing + resume semantics will take longer.
julian: I'll accept plan: core truncation + 413 early reject for GA in 1 week; streaming resume beta in 6 weeks with Dedicated SLA.
maria: Great. Next steps: alex to write PRD section for acceptance criteria + add the table for Hosted vs Dedicated behavior. samir to write infra tradeoff note. qa-bot to populate tests. emily to sync sales on timeline. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to sign off. :calendar:

launch-council: Noting for records: this thread captured initial scope negotiation and launch criteria for Gen API edge-cases. We'll review PRD during Thurs council. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks all — will post the PRD draft here when ready.
